# Why I Keep a Learning Log

2026-01-18

---

This is a placeholder post. The title is a prompt, not a claim about the author's real habits.

A learning log records small experiments: what was tried, what failed, and what to read next. Short entries are easier to keep than long essays.

The most useful entry is often the one that explains a mistake clearly enough to avoid repeating it.
